name: type: compatibility
description: Fails with a particular OS, instrument, file format or other software

name: type: performance
description: Unusable run time or memory use

name: type: documentation
description: Documentation is wrong or misleading about behaviour

name: severity: critical
description: Wrong results or data loss in common use

name: severity: major
description: Blocks a workflow or wrong results in specific use

name: impact: silent result change
description: Results change without an error or warning

name: vendor: not contacted
description: Not yet sent to the vendor

name: vendor: reported
description: Sent to the vendor, no reply yet

name: vendor: fixed
description: Vendor shipped a fix; version in the issue body

name: vendor: won't fix
description: Vendor considers it intended or out of scope

name: needs triage
description: New report, labels not yet checked by a maintainer

name: needs repro
description: Not yet reproduced with shareable input
